solutions.you_do: Install Fistron, connect it to your coding assistant and ask it about your branch, a failed job or a file.
solutions.fistron_does: Your assistant calls Fistron's tools on your working copy: the review your pull request would get, the RCA of the job, the plan's missing tests.
solutions.you_get: Findings with their file and line, the failure's cause and the tests a file lacks, each from Fistron's own analysis.

solutions.you_do: Tell Fistron's people the quality problem to solve and connect your CI, repositories and tests.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron's people design and run the solution with the platform: a test plan per change, analyses of each failure, the gaps closed through requests you approve.
solutions.you_get: A solved problem with its evidence: the plan of what each change needs, and reports you can show management, customers and auditors.

pictures.name: test-plan
pictures.alt: Fistron's test plan of a change: the checks it needs, each with its outcome and the evidence that decides it.
pictures.caption: A test plan of a synthetic change (examples/change/change-pool-settings), made by fistron plan.

solutions.you_do: Connect your CI history and your suite.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron audits the suite's health: flaky, slow, redundant and weak tests, each with its evidence and a recommendation.
solutions.you_get: A ranked list of what to fix first, and repairs proposed as pull requests you review.

pictures.name: suite-health
pictures.alt: Fistron's Suite Health audit: the tests that work badly and the recommendations, each with its evidence.
pictures.caption: A Suite Health audit of a synthetic suite (the demo's document).

solutions.fistron_does: Fistron measures how long the team waits for a verdict and proposes tiers of tests that catch the same failures sooner.
solutions.you_get: The wait measured, tiers proposed and replayed on your history, and the failures each tier would have caught.

pictures.name: feedback-loop
pictures.alt: Fistron's Fast Feedback Loop: how long the team waits for a verdict, by stage.
pictures.caption: The feedback loop of a synthetic team (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Let Fistron review your pull and merge requests.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron checks each change with evidence: tests, coverage of the changed lines, scanners, the AI review, each finding with its file and line.
solutions.you_get: A review that says what is not proven, before a person approves the change.

pictures.name: review
pictures.alt: Fistron's review of a pull request: the findings by level and by rule, each with its evidence.
pictures.caption: The review of a synthetic pull request (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Ask Fistron to explain your change or a module of the codebase.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron explains it from the code's evidence: its callers, its tests and its coverage; a model's words held to those facts.
solutions.you_get: An explanation you can trust, a check that you understood your change, and your own learning path, private to you.

pictures.name: annotated-code
pictures.alt: Fistron's Become a developer page: a branch of a small shop shown as its code, beside each changed function what it affects and which tests name it.
pictures.caption: A branch of a fictional shop (examples/showcase-shop) explained for real from the code's evidence alone, beside the lines it explains. With a model, its words come labelled and held to these facts.

solutions.you_do: Do the manual test; after each step, tell the agent it is done.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron's agent reads the evidence from the product's API and read-only commands, checks each step by rules and compares it with the automated run of the same test.
solutions.you_get: A verified record with its rounds, the ticket's comment ready to post, and the manual steps no test covers as gaps of your test plan.

pictures.name: verification-log
pictures.alt: Fistron's Manual verification record: a ticket's rounds, each step's checks with their evidence, and a question left for the person.
pictures.caption: The record of a synthetic ticket (the demo's document): a fictional operating system verified by hand, its evidence read by the agent.

solutions.you_do: Choose the framework and connect your tools.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron assesses each control from the evidence your tools hold and says which are met, which are not and why.
solutions.you_get: A control assessment with its gaps, the evidence of each control, and an audit package for your auditor.

pictures.name: control-assessment
pictures.alt: Fistron's control assessment: each control met or not, with its evidence and its gaps.
pictures.caption: A control assessment of a synthetic organisation (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Name the programme's requirements and let its participants run the vendor's validation kit.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron runs the kit on each participant's agent and gathers the results into the programme's release gate.
solutions.you_get: A release gate with each requirement's state from every participant's builds.

pictures.name: release-gate
pictures.alt: Fistron's release gate of a programme: each requirement with its state from the participants' builds.
pictures.caption: The release gate of a synthetic programme (the demo's document).

solutions.fistron_does: Fistron measures each goal from your CI, your tests and your changes, every quarter against the baseline.
solutions.you_get: Metrics with their evidence, and a quarterly review of where you stand.

pictures.name: outcomes
pictures.alt: Fistron's outcome values: each quality metric with its value and the evidence it comes from.
pictures.caption: The outcome values of a synthetic project (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Let Fistron review your changes and releases, with your scanners' results.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron checks each change's dependencies against their registries and your approved list, and reads your scanners' findings, each with its line; the act's framework profile is planned.
solutions.you_get: Release evidence the act asks for today: what each change adds, what was found and how it was handled.

pictures.name: dependencies
pictures.alt: Fistron's review of a change: a package its lock file adds that no registry has, on the lock file's line.
pictures.caption: The review of a synthetic change (examples/change-ai/ai-nonexistent-package), made by fistron review findings. The act's own framework profile is planned; this is what works today.

solutions.you_do: Name what a supplier's delivery must pass.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron runs the acceptance on your agent and judges the delivery by its evidence.
solutions.you_get: An acceptance record of each delivery, with what passed and what did not.

pictures.name: validation-run
pictures.alt: Fistron's validation run of a delivery: each check of the kit with its outcome.
pictures.caption: The validation run of a synthetic delivery (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Name the installation to migrate and its rehearsal targets.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron inventories them before and after the migration, read-only, and compares what changed.
solutions.you_get: The regressions of a rehearsal, the requirements checked and an attestation that a rollback is safe.

pictures.name: comparison
pictures.alt: Fistron's comparison of an installation before and after its migration: what changed, the regressions first.
pictures.caption: The comparison of a synthetic rehearsal (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Run your recovery or rollback rehearsal.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron checks with evidence that the installation came back as it was.
solutions.you_get: An attestation of the recovery, signed, for your auditor.

pictures.name: attestation
pictures.alt: Fistron's attestation: a rollback proven safe, with the evidence of each check.
pictures.caption: The attestation of a synthetic rehearsal (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Write your team's rules, or start from a pack.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron audits the repository by them and reviews each change by them: tools, evidence and a model, each finding with its rule.
solutions.you_get: The places that break your rules, a trend, credit to a change that removes them, and rules learned from your reviewers.

pictures.name: audit
pictures.alt: Fistron's audit of a repository by the team's rules: the places that break them, by rule and file.
pictures.caption: The audit of a synthetic repository (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Set your data-flow policy and choose your models.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron records every contact of a run, and refuses one the policy does not allow before it is made.
solutions.you_get: A data-flow ledger of each run: where your data went, to which model and with which class.

pictures.name: data-flow
pictures.alt: Fistron's data-flow ledger of a run: each contact, its place and what the policy refused.
pictures.caption: The data-flow ledger of a synthetic run (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Name the CI jobs your team reviews every morning.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron reviews them each night: each failure analysed, the known ones recognised, the new ones with their cause.
solutions.you_get: The Daily CI review ready before the team starts, in the words of your team's report.

pictures.name: daily-ci-review
pictures.alt: Fistron's Daily CI review: the night's failures, the known ones and the new ones with their cause.
pictures.caption: A Daily CI review of a public project's synthetic run (the demo's document).

solutions.you_do: Answer the checklist of your team's practices.
solutions.fistron_does: Fistron compares your answers with the signals of your CI and your issues.
solutions.you_get: Where your team stands, the answers the signals do not agree with, and the next steps.

pictures.name: journey
pictures.alt: Fistron's Agile Transformation record: the team's practices, the answers the signals do not agree with.
pictures.caption: The record of a synthetic team (the demo's document).
